title: OpenCode runs plugins in Bun: the adapter must import no DD module
body:
Keep the OpenCode adapter free of DD imports: it spawns `node hooks/run.cjs session-start` and injects the hook's additionalContext. Export only the default plugin function (constants go in adapters/opencode/frame.js), and keep the package.json `./server` export pointing at it.

Why: OpenCode loads the package's ./server export and runs it in Bun, which has no node:sqlite, so importing DD's store fails at load. It also calls every export of the module as a plugin, so an exported constant fails with 'Plugin export is not a function'. Without ./server it never loads the plugin at all, silently, which is why an earlier `opencode debug startup` check looked clean.

evidence.summary: Header comment records the Bun/node:sqlite failure found 2026-09-24 and the spawn-the-hook design
Test asserts the adapter imports only node:child_process, node:url and ./frame.js, exports only default, and package.json has ./server

v1.trigger: Before editing adapters/opencode/index.js or adding an import or export to it
